purpose: Three alternative hero concepts for approval; no changes to the live hero.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished, polished high-fidelity desktop website HERO SECTION design mockup for Flamee, a Vietnamese couples memory app. Single wide horizontal 16:9 canvas, approximately 1600x900. Full hero only, not a whole page or a presentation board. No browser chrome, no device showing the website, no captions or concept labels outside the site.
Shared layout: warm linen solid background #F2EDE6 with extremely subtle warm sunlight rays. Ink #302924, coral #FF7158. Generous side margins, 1200px-equivalent centered content. Header at top is a FULL-WIDTH stable row within these margins: small orange flame symbol and 'Flamee' at far left; 'Kỷ niệm', 'Kết nối', 'Câu hỏi' aligned right; dark charcoal rounded 'Gói thành viên ↗' button at far right. Do NOT center the brand. Do NOT shrink this header into a narrow pill.
Hero body must be SPLIT: LEFT 46% contains all headline, description, CTA; RIGHT 54% contains the visual concept. Left text aligned to header brand, vertically centered in hero. Headline EXACTLY two lines 'Một bên bạn.' and 'Một bên mình.' in a large DELICATE THIN HIGH-CONTRAST SERIF ITALIC font, elegant light book typography with fine hairlines and real serifs; neither bold serif nor handwritten script. Whole headline italic, ink dark brown. Size roughly 76px, readable Vietnamese accents. Under it short sans-serif text 'Lưu những ngày có nhau,' then 'viết tiếp chuyện hai mình.' at approximately 18px with comfortable line spacing. Below, coral primary pill 'Khám phá Flamee ↗' and quiet text link 'Cách kết nối →' on same horizontal row. Small sans serif and tidy controls. Keep copy legible. No fake metrics, testimonials, store badges, extra floating labels, gradients on text, purple/blue, heavy drop shadows, tiny unreadable paragraphs, or card-grid spam. Modern editorial, warm, intimate, quietly premium. Left and right have generous separation. Header identity and typography hierarchy must match the described layout.
RIGHT VISUAL CONCEPT: The app itself is the main picture. One large upright slim ivory iPhone in a modest three-quarter angle, showing a convincing warm white Flamee 'Kỷ niệm' screen with a real monthly calendar of small memory-photo thumbnails and subtle coral controls. The phone dominates the right half, full device visible, bottom safely within frame. Behind it, only ONE larger lightly tilted square photograph of a smiling young adult Vietnamese couple in natural warm sunlight, as a tactile paper memory print. In front near the lower edge, ONE small cropped app panel reading 'Hôm nay của hai mình' with three tiny orange mood faces. Soft physically plausible shadows, no abstract blobs, no circles, no halo, no card nest. Keep the visual poised and product-focused, achievable with existing app screenshots and photos. The right composition has one clear focal phone.

One paper date-tab '12.10', a single fine handwritten note 'Ngày có nhau' inside the book, and one restrained coral bookmark ribbon.
